card.name: "of" after risk, before cancer
card.fires_on: The word "of" or "for" right after "increased risk" or "remote risk" in radiation-exposure and infection-risk warnings. It is strongest when cancer or disease transmission comes next.

modes.label: Radiation and cancer risk

modes.example: Radiation exposure is associated with a dose-dependent increased risk<< of>> cancer.

modes.label: Remote risk of transmission
modes.description: "for" after "remote risk" in blood-product infection warnings.
modes.example: it carries an extremely remote risk<< for>> transmission of viral diseases.
